name: permissions
description: Pheonix Three-Tier Permission Modes (Always Ask, Ask on Changes, Auto-Review), Risk Scoring, and Human-in-the-Loop Approval Governance

changes: Three distinct security tiers: Always Ask (all actions gated), Ask on Changes (reads permitted, mutations gated), Auto-Review (autonomous low/medium risk, high-risk gated)
Heuristic RiskScorer detecting destructive commands and sensitive paths
Thread-safe ApprovalQueue with programmatic approval, rejection, and deadline expiration
Append-only SQLiteAuditStore for tamper-resistant governance logging
